_readme: Curated overview data for admin/repo-map.html — the branch/workflow inventory.
This file supplies the 'why' a GitHub API call cannot answer: category, purpose,
and a recommendation per branch and workflow. The page overlays this with LIVE
data (ahead/behind, last run, last commit) fetched from the GitHub API at view time.
'category' for workflows: content-import | enrichment | ocr | search-index |
Hand-maintained. Update when a branch/workflow's role changes — this is not
Analysis date: 2026-09-05. Verified via: git merge-base --is-ancestor (ancestry),
git diff --stat against origin/main (content overlap), and the GitHub PR list

snapshot.* on each branch = git-verified data as of the analysis date above (ahead/behind vs main, ancestry, last commit). Baked in so the page shows real numbers with zero GitHub API calls; a per-branch 'Refresh live' button re-checks on demand.

ask-claude.yml.display_name: Ask Claude — live replies to the website inbox
ask-claude.yml.purpose: Runs a Claude Code session on GitHub's runner whenever the Ask Claude tab commits a request into tasks/inbox/. Claude reads the request, answers or makes the change (changes go to a branch and a pull request, never straight to main), and commits its reply into the same file, which the page is polling.
ask-claude.yml.notes: Needs one repository secret: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (console.anthropic.com) or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (`claude setup-token` on a subscription). Spends Anthropic credits, never Gemini. Skips its own reply commits so it cannot loop.
ask-claude.yml.reason: The live half of Ask Claude; without it replies wait for Sunday.

generated.name: Ask Claude — answer inbox requests

inputs.label: Inbox id to answer (blank = every request whose status is pending)

writes: commits directly to the branch it ran on

check-sources.yml.notes: This is the file behind every 'Online source syncer' card: a card runs it with only=<that site>. Runs by itself twice a month.
check-sources.yml.reason: The fortnightly watch on all sources; cheap, safe, no secrets.

inputs.label: Check only these source ids (comma-separated; blank = all)

inputs.label: Record what was seen, so the next run reports only what is new
